```xml
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="organisation" name="Organisation" processRef="organisation-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="organisation-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="organisation-lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="parent-lane" name="Parent">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>letParentSelect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>decideAboutExtension</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>extendGateway</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="organisation-lane" name="Organisation">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>fetchInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>collectInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifySplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifySocialSecurity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifyCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifyJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gatherInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endOfPeriod</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>extendedEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endedEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Becoming a parent" />

    <bpmn:task id="fetchInformation" name="Fetch information about potential models" />
    <bpmn:task id="letParentSelect" name="Let parent select" />
    <bpmn:task id="collectInformation" name="Collect relevant information" />

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="notifySplit" name="Notify in time" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifyCompany" name="Notify Company" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="notifyJoin" />

    <bpmn:task id="gatherInformation" name="Gather information from companies" />

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="endOfPeriod" name="End of period">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration>P3M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="decideAboutExtension" name="Decide about extension" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="extendGateway" name="Extend leave?" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="extendedEnd" name="Leave extended" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endedEnd" name="Leave ended" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="fetchInformation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="fetchInformation" targetRef="letParentSelect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="letParentSelect" targetRef="collectInformation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="collectInformation" targetRef="notifySplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="notifySplit" targetRef="notifySocialSecurity" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="notifySplit" targetRef="notifyCompany" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="notifySocialSecurity" targetRef="notifyJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="notifyCompany" targetRef="notifyJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="notifyJoin" targetRef="gatherInformation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="gatherInformation" targetRef="endOfPeriod" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="endOfPeriod" targetRef="decideAboutExtension" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="decideAboutExtension" targetRef="extendGateway" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" name="yes" sourceRef="extendGateway" targetRef="extendedEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">extend = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" name="no" sourceRef="extendGateway" targetRef="endedEnd" default="f14" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```
